newsitem.title: USA: OMI Corp files to offer 12 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: OMI Corp files to offer 12 mln shares.

text.p: OMI Corp said Friday it had filed for a public offering of 12 million shares.
It said 9.6 million shares will be offered in the United States and 2.4 million will be offered internationally.
Proceeds will be used to repay debts and to acquire new and used vessels, it said.
The shipping company said that to be eligible for U.S. coast-wide trade, U.S. law requires a corporation owning a vessel to be at least 75 percent domestically owned.

In order to ensure the company is able to deliver shares as part of the international offering, OMI said its board has raised the minimum percentage of shares which must be held by U.S. citizens to 90 percent. The minimum percentage will be reduced to 77 percent following the offering, it said.
